exit_criteria: AC1: Dark Appearance section banners remove the reported bright white-on-white flash.
AC2: Header background and text use existing application theme roles with restrained contrast.
AC3: Light, high-contrast and live theme changes preserve legibility and update all section headers.
AC4: Actual offscreen Appearance renders and the composed theme-switch path pass; a self-contained frozen build and fresh attended Accept/Reject candidate carry the remaining owner visual judgement.
Focused checks, documentation gate, explicit commits and a durable checkpoint agree with the exact candidate and pending human obligation.
milestones.boundary: Finish all independent engineering and bookkeeping, then hand the short attended session to the coordinator; do not infer the owner visual verdict.
